changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_community_player_ids(p_player_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (player_id uuid) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( -- auth.uid() is read from the request JWT and is unaffected -- by SECURITY DEFINER, so this is the caller, not the owner. -- An anonymous caller resolves to no rows, and every CTE -- below joins to this one, so the whole result is empty. SELECT pp.id FROM player_profiles pp WHERE pp.user_id = auth.uid() AND (p_player_id IS NULL OR p_player_id = pp.id) ), my_matches AS ( SELECT mp.match_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN me ON me.id = mp.player_id ), candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM me UNION SELECT CASE WHEN p.player1_id = me.id THEN p.player2_id ELSE p.player1_id END FROM partnerships p JOIN me ON me.id IN (p.player1_id, p.player2_id) UNION SELECT CASE WHEN t.owner_player_id = me.id THEN t.member_player_id ELSE t.owner_player_id END FROM team_ups t JOIN me ON me.id IN (t.owner_player_id, t.member_player_id) WHERE t.status = 'accepted' UNION -- Everyone who was on court, both sides of the net. Verified -- only, since an unverified match is a claim, not a game. SELECT mp.player_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN my_matches mm ON mm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' ) SELECT c.id FROM candidates c WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_relationships b, me WHERE b.relationship_type = 'block' AND b.status = 'active' AND ( (b.from_player_id = me.id AND b.to_player_id = c.id) OR (b.from_player_id = c.id AND b.to_player_id = me.id) ) ); $$;

rollback.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_community_player_ids(p_player_id uuid) RETURNS TABLE (player_id uuid) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( SELECT p_player_id AS id WHERE p_player_id IS NOT NULL ), my_matches AS ( SELECT mp.match_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN me ON me.id = mp.player_id ), candidates AS ( SELECT id FROM me UNION SELECT CASE WHEN p.player1_id = me.id THEN p.player2_id ELSE p.player1_id END FROM partnerships p JOIN me ON me.id IN (p.player1_id, p.player2_id) UNION SELECT CASE WHEN t.owner_player_id = me.id THEN t.member_player_id ELSE t.owner_player_id END FROM team_ups t JOIN me ON me.id IN (t.owner_player_id, t.member_player_id) WHERE t.status = 'accepted' UNION SELECT mp.player_id FROM match_participants mp JOIN my_matches mm ON mm.match_id = mp.match_id JOIN matches m ON m.id = mp.match_id WHERE m.status = 'verified' ) SELECT c.id FROM candidates c WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM player_relationships b WHERE b.relationship_type = 'block' AND b.status = 'active' AND ( (b.from_player_id = p_player_id AND b.to_player_id = c.id) OR (b.from_player_id = c.id AND b.to_player_id = p_player_id) ) ); $$;

changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fn_feed_for_player( p_player_id uuid, p_limit int DEFAULT 20, p_offset int DEFAULT 0, p_types text[] DEFAULT NULL, p_since timestamptz DEFAULT NULL, p_scope text DEFAULT 'community' ) RETURNS TABLE ( id uuid, actor_player_id uuid, actor_club_id uuid, activity_type varchar(50), reference_type varchar(50), reference_id uuid, visibility varchar(20), metadata jsonb, created_at timestamptz, geo_score int ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public AS $$ WITH me AS ( SELECT pp.id FROM player_profiles pp WHERE pp.user_id = auth.uid() ), effective AS ( -- An anonymous caller keeps the public listing it gets -- today; RLS on `activities` already publishes exactly -- these rows, so this is not a widening. An authenticated -- caller is always scoped to their own community, which is -- the only thing the application ever asks for - so the -- caller can no longer request the firehose for themselves, -- or a community that is not theirs. SELECT (SELECT m.id FROM me m) AS player_id, CASE WHEN (SELECT m.id FROM me m) IS NULL THEN 'geo' ELSE 'community' END AS scope ), community AS ( SELECT c.player_id FROM fn_community_player_ids((SELECT e.player_id FROM effective e)) c WHERE (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) = 'community' ), my_clubs AS ( SELECT cm.club_id FROM club_memberships cm WHERE (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) = 'community' AND cm.player_id = (SELECT e.player_id FROM effective e) AND cm.status = 'active' ), scored AS ( SELECT a.id, a.actor_player_id, a.actor_club_id, a.activity_type, a.reference_type, a.reference_id, a.visibility, a.metadata, a.created_at, COALESCE( CASE WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.barangay, c.barangay))) = lower(btrim(v.barangay)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) THEN 3 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.city, c.city))) = lower(btrim(v.city)) AND lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 2 WHEN lower(btrim(COALESCE(pp.province, c.province))) = lower(btrim(v.province)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, 0 ) AS geo_score, CASE WHEN c.verification_status = 'verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS verified_score FROM activities a LEFT JOIN player_profiles pp ON pp.id = a.actor_player_id LEFT JOIN clubs c ON c.id = a.actor_club_id LEFT JOIN player_profiles v ON v.id = (SELECT e.player_id FROM effective e) WHERE a.visibility = 'public' AND (p_types IS NULL OR a.activity_type = ANY(p_types)) AND (p_since IS NULL OR a.created_at > p_since) AND ( (SELECT e.scope FROM effective e) <> 'community' OR a.actor_player_id IN (SELECT cp.player_id FROM community cp) OR a.actor_club_id IN (SELECT mc.club_id FROM my_clubs mc) ) ) SELECT s.id, s.actor_player_id, s.actor_club_id, s.activity_type, s.reference_type, s.reference_id, s.visibility, s.metadata, s.created_at, s.geo_score FROM scored s -- `id` makes this a total order. Without it, rows sharing a -- transaction timestamp sort arbitrarily and OFFSET paging can -- repeat one page's row on the next. ORDER BY s.geo_score DESC, s.verified_score DESC, s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset; $$;
